description: This PHP source file defines a Validator class used for validating input parameters according to specified rules. It forms part of the OrangeHRM core API version 2, providing mechanisms to enforce validation rules, handle exceptions, and process various validation scenarios within the API.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Provides static methods for validating input parameters based on rules, handling exceptions, and enforcing data integrity within the OrangeHRM API.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the provided array of values against a set of rules, throwing exceptions if validation fails.

methods.name: getOnlyNecessaryValues
methods.description: Filters the input values to exclude parameters based on the rule collection's exclusion list.
